propositions: Core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) import vendor-specific adapters.jira code that must be eliminated per epic bbf1 AC3 zero-import requirement.
Backend Protocol lacks scalar, translation-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) needed to abstract vendor scope and readiness concerns.
Nested function-level lazy imports in four modules require full-tree AST inspection (ast.walk), not just top-level analysis, to detect and prevent regression.
JiraBackend, FakeBackend, and S2 contract suite must be extended to implement new Protocol members while preserving existing fail-closed and soft-fail semantics.
Two neutral exception types (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) must be defined in _backend.py so consumers catch vendor-agnostic base rather than jira-specific subclass.
